text: The vough is a Scottish folk figure. The being is also called fuath and brollachan. It was the most feared apparition in the Scottish Highlands. A person could catch it but not hold it. One catch dissolved into a smear of jellyfish. The name vough means hatred or aversion. The creature usually wore green. The word brollachan marks the larval stage.
